purpose: Build toolchain for the native Windows encrypted store lane. Not a product dependency: it appears in no Cargo.lock, no package.json dependency set, and no product feature graph.
openssl_asm_note: nasm.exe is deliberately not placed on PATH, so openssl-src passes `no-asm` to Configure. The distribution ships a nasm.exe in c\bin; using it would require the ad-hoc PATH change t068 section 8.2 rejects. Algorithms, key derivation, and parameters are unchanged by this; only the assembly-optimised implementations are.
